title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; colour HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
displayModel: The photograph's light is decomposed into a midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 334 pc (s4G's exponential disc scale length, 54.89″ (Salo et al. 2015), over 7.3, Kregel et al. 2002). Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.3333333 degrees wide, tangent projection on 143.04, +21.500556, north up; no crop or resample.
